notes.title: Update!
notes.content: In this update, we completely redesigned the landscape of the park. A winter biome has been added for which we have many plans. Importantly, sounds were added. And many more small details are waiting for you in this update. In the near future we will work on adding a plot to our game.

notes.title: Country Park Remake!
notes.content:
Today is a grand update for Country Park! We gave him the name "Remake". Now we have started using the Unreal Engine to make the park more realistic. This is only the first update, but soon you will find many other updates. We have many plans for Country Park, and we will try to please you with the development of the functionality and graphics of the game!

    Changes in this update

*Now the game is based on the Unreal Engine

*Added a house that you can explore

*Appeared objects with physics

*Added change of time of day
